docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY RAMOS, JOSE AS TO DEFENDANT HUANG, WEI ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-06-2022 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $110) SERVED JUN-13-2022, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT HUANG, WEI

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-06-2022 - CONTINUED FOR INTERPRETERS TO AUG-17-2022 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF JOSE RAMOS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WEI HUANG IS PRESENT ASSISTED BY NON-CERTIFIED TOISANESE INTERPRETER SUSAN HUANG, DAUGHTER. MS. HUANG WAS GIVEN THE INTERPRETER'S OATH BY THE COURTROOM CLERK. MR. RAMOS ASKED FOR AN INTERPRETER "JUST IN CASE" BUT IS CONFIDENT IN HIS ENGLISH SKILLS. THE COURT FINDS THAT AN CERTIFIED INTERPRETER FOR MR. HUANG IS APPROPRIATE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER TO CONTINUE FOR INTERPRETERS. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF AUG-17-2022 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF AUG-17-2022 BY JUDGE PRO TEM. PLAINTIFF JOSE RAMOS IS PRESENT, ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED SPANISH INTERPRETER PILAR ESPINOZA. DEFENDANT WEI HUANG IS PRESENT, ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED TOISANESE INTERPRETER KOK WU. BOTH PARTIES STIPULATED TO HAVE THEIR MATTER HEARD BY THE PRO TEM JUDGE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: GREG GROENEVELD; CLERK: A. DATT. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-17-2022 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RAMOS, JOSE RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT HUANG, WEI $5,150.00 PRINCIPAL, $185.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,335.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
STIPULATION TO USE JUDGE PRO TEM. FILED BY RAMOS, JOSE HUANG, WEI
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT HUANG, WEI
